interest: Shows 1940-44 US tracking of Japan's wartime raw-material purchases abroad, asset liquidation, and bondholder claims.
overview: This file comprises twenty State Department 'List of Papers' docket sheets (Sheets 71 through 89, plus a Military Intelligence Division index sheet) recording incoming and outgoing correspondence under decimal file 894.51 between January 1940 and May 1944. The recorded documents track Japanese national budgets, government bond issues, and gold bullion shipments across the Pacific and Latin America, alongside U.S. and Allied countermeasures such as foreign fund controls, asset freezing, and securities regulations. The docket sheets also register pre-war commercial credit negotiations in Australia, China, and South America, followed by wartime intelligence reports on Japan's domestic budget debates and numerous inquiries from American citizens holding defaulted Japanese government and municipal dollar bonds.
